semantics.evidence: Original problem connects XNOR(in1,in2) to XOR with in3, whose output is out.
semantics.timing: Pure combinational propagation; no clock or cycle latency specified.
semantics.reset: No reset port or reset behavior in original problem.
semantics.initialization: No stored state or initialization specified; output follows inputs.

numeric.domain: Boolean gates with standard SystemVerilog four-state propagation

verification.oracle: Explicit truth table derived from original XNOR followed by XOR description, independent of DUT expression.
verification.coverage: All eight binary combinations in ascending and descending order; supplementary X/Z propagation cases.
verification.sampling: Check after 1 ns combinational settling on each stimulus.
verification.failure: Case inequality comparison and $fatal; bounded timeout.
verification.pass: PASS printed only after all comparisons succeed.
